api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('dkd')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', teacher_logits, alpha, beta, temperature)
description: Decoupled Knowledge Distillation from §3.1 Eqs. (2), (5)-(6) and §3.3 Eq. (7): temperature-scaled target-class binary KL (TCKD) and conditional non-target KL (NCKD), weighted independently and multiplied by temperature squared. Teacher logits are detached; ignored rows follow the valid-row reduction convention in src/topologies/implementations/losses/lwf.py:108-113.

examples.title: Train a student with decoupled knowledge distillation

name: Decoupled Knowledge Distillation loss

parameters.alpha: required finite real coefficient for target-class binary KL (TCKD)
parameters.beta: required finite real coefficient for conditional non-target KL (NCKD)
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index excluded from loss and mean reduction (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point student logits with shape [B, C], where B > 0 and C >= 2
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean over valid samples, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer class indices with shape [B], in [0, C) except optional ignore_index
parameters.teacher_logits: required floating-point teacher logits with shape [B, C]; teacher gradients are detached
parameters.temperature: required finite positive divisor for both logits, with final T-squared scaling
